Commentary.Commentary: Zimbabwe will have to show a lot more fight than they did in the first game. Pakistan on the other hand, will hope their bowlers can do what they managed to do in the last game. Join us shortly!
The Zimbabwe bowlers had to toil hard. The pitch wasn't offering much, but they did manage to bowl with good discipline. Muzarabani and Chisoro were the pick for them but everybody bowled decently.

Those two along with Azhar Ali were the major contributors. Apart from them, nobody managed to cross the 30-run mark for Pakistan. Abid Ali was the mainstay with his first double ton. He batted throughout the innings and probably batted his side to a position from where they can’t lose the game.

A superb batting effort then by Pakistan as they have finally declared. Nauman’s ton was what they were waiting for but that was not to be. Still though courtesy his effort and the star of the bat for them, Abid Ali, they have got to a massive first innings score.

This session has been all about Pakistan. They have added 152 runs in this session, and have also not lost a single wicket. Abid Ali has crossed the landmark and has gone past the 200-run mark, whereas, Nauman Ali is on 93 out there. With them crossing the 500-run mark, they will be looking to declare the innings maybe in this Tea session, or maybe, they might let Nauman go out there and get to his ton, and then, they might look to declare. Zimbabwe bowlers have toiled hard but to no avail here, especially, in the last one hour, where both these batters have gone hammer and tongs. It will be interesting to see what Pakistan does. Join us for the third and final session of the day shortly.

Hello, folks! We are back for the second day of the second Test between Pakistan and Zimbabwe. For most of the first day, Pakistan dominated due to the brilliance of the two Ali's - Azhar and Abid. But then, towards the last 10 overs of the day, Zimbabwe came back nicely and snared 3 wickets in no time to finish the day nicely. Now, the hosts will be looking to continue the same work and bundle Pakistan out, before they post a mammoth total. Will they be able to do so? Join us as we bring you all the action from Day 2.

So Pakistan are in a strong position not as strong as they looked at one stage. They will look to continue their dominance on Day 2 as well. Zimbabwe's late burst has got them back in this game. The hosts will look to build on this momentum on Day 2. Join us on, Saturday, 8th May, 2021 for action of Day 2 of this Test to find out. The action begins at 0930 local (0730 GMT). An energetic end from Zimbabwe has seen them stay alive in this game. It looked doomy and gloomy when Pakistan were cruising. The second new ball though has done the trick for the hosts with Muzarabani coming back strongly at the end of the day to finish with a 3-fer and see Pakistan fall from 248/1 to 264/4. Ngarava was the only other wicket-taker. It was a tough day prior to the arrival of the second new ball as the previous ball was not doing much. The fielders did not help the cause either as Abid was given a lifeline. The finish to the day though will encourage and revitalize Zimbabwe and they will look to start Day 2 with energy.

After electing to bat, Pakistan did not get off to a good start as they lost Imran Butt early. The tourists were very cautious in the first session. That was the calm before the storm as the pair of Azhar and Abid dominated the day. The duo added a 236-run stand for the second wicket with both the batters getting to their tons. Azhar though could not see off the day as he succumbed to the second new ball's tricks for a well-made 126. Babar disappointed once again with the bat as he failed to capitalize on the platform set. Last game's centurion Fawad too fell prey to Zimbabwe's late charge. Abid though is still out in the middle unbeaten on 118 along with nightwatchman Sajid Khan.

A strong end to the day for Zimbabwe as they have made the second new ball dance to their tunes and ensured they are not completely out of this Test. It looked like Pakistan were running away with the day but 3 wickets with the second new ball has kept Zimbabwe in this game at the end of the day and added some respectability to the score. Pakistan though will still be happy with their overall outing.

Brendan Taylor, the Zimbabwe skipper, says that they would have batted first. Adds that Masvaure has injured himself and Luke Jongwe replaces him. Tells that they have confident guys in their team and they can take some positives from the first game

Babar Azam, the Pakistan skipper, says that they will bat first. Adds that the wicket is dry and they will look to post a big score. Informs that they have made one change as Faheem Ashraf is replaced by Tabish Khan. Goes onto say that they will need to rectify their mistakes.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo says that the conditions are perfect for cricket. Adds that the pitch is very dry and there is some grass on it and it will assist the seamers. Goes onto it is slightly similar to the first Test match. Tells that the pitch might play a little slow.

Hello and a warm welcome to the second Test between Zimbabwe and Pakistan. Pakistan are 1-0 up on the 2-match series and they are the favourites to make it 2-0. Their batting has clicked while their bowling has done extremely well and they would be confident that they can put up another fine show. Zimbabwe, on the other hand, will still miss the services of Sean Williams. Brendan Taylor has suggested that they will play the same combination and they would need to perform a lot better than they did in the first Test and give a tough fight to the visitors. Can we see Zimbabwe level the series or will Pakistan make it 2-0? We will find out.
